sources.title: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking model card
sources.evidence: Exact Thinking checkpoint weight repository; Apache-2.0 license; visual reasoning, document/OCR, GUI-agent and video capabilities. Describes native 256K context and an optional extension to 1M.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration; text and vision configurations; 128 experts with 8 selected per token; max_position_embeddings 262144; separate image and video token IDs.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL official repository and release news
sources.evidence: Identifies Alibaba Cloud Qwen team as developer. Dated 2025.09.23 news explicitly announces release of both 235B-A22B Instruct and Thinking checkpoints.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report, section 2
sources.evidence: Architecture has a vision encoder, vision-language mergers and a Qwen3 language backbone. The Large Language Model subsection labels the 235B-A22B flagship as 235B parameters and 22B activated per token; the vision encoder and mergers are discussed separately.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint safetensors metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Qwen checkpoint
sources.evidence: API reports safetensors.total = 235670022896 and the same BF16 parameter count for the full uploaded checkpoint. Repository creation is 2025-09-22, which is not used as public release evidence.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Accepts text, image and video content; emits a thinking prefix; formats tool definitions, assistant tool calls and tool responses. Fetched directly after the browser tool could not access the initially attempted .jinja filename.

name.note: Catalog display spelling corresponds to official Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud.

family.note: Qwen3-VL is within the Qwen model family.

release_date.note: Explicit developer release announcement for this checkpoint takes precedence over repository creation on September 22.

open_weights.note: Developer publishes the full checkpoint weights.

parameters_b.note: 235,670,022,896 stored parameters divided by 1e9. This is the complete multimodal checkpoint. The 235B name/report figure is nominal and appears in the report language-backbone discussion.

active_parameters_b.note: Published nominal 22B activated per token, stated in the language-model subsection; 8 of 128 experts are selected. This is not an exact full-multimodal activation count: vision-encoder/merger work depends on visual input and no combined active count is stated.

architecture.note: Multimodal model with an MoE language decoder plus vision encoder and projection/DeepStack mergers.

context_window.note: Native configured maximum; optional extrapolation to 1M is not the default checkpoint context window.

modalities.note: Checkpoint supports video as well as image/text input and generates text.

reasoning.note: Separate Thinking checkpoint with an explicit thinking generation prefix.

tool_call.note: Exact template implements function definitions, tool-call serialization and tool-response turns; model card describes tool-using visual agents.

description.value: Qwen vision-language thinking model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: Concise capability description is supported without unsupported benchmark or superiority claims.

patch.notes: Full multimodal checkpoint contains 235.670022896B stored parameters according to its safetensors metadata. The nominal 235B/22B figures are presented in the technical report language-model subsection; 22B denotes published per-token language-model activation, not a separately measured full-multimodal active count. Native context is 262144 tokens; optional extension to 1M requires configuration changes.

summary: Correct license to Apache-2.0, full checkpoint size to 235.670022896B, native context to 262144 and add video input. Confirm September 23 release, MoE architecture, Thinking behavior and tool-call template. Preserve the developer nominal 22B active figure with an explicit language-model scope caveat; no exact full-multimodal active count is disclosed.
